source_result: GMI_DOMAIN_ALGEBRA_EXECUTED_V1.md GMI-DA1 (a domain is a carrier/law pair of the primitive alphabet), GMI-DA4 (capacity vs compression gates), GMI-DA5 (precision as a domain gate) and section 9 (what would actually make a new kingdom); GMI_GAP_LEDGER_EXECUTED_V1.md gap G5 (CLOSED by RV-377-045: two declared precision instruments with identical charged operation sequences now run side by side) whose CONSEQUENCE was never executed -- the kingdom question has never been asked on the precision axis; GMI_STRUCTURAL_DOMAINS_KINGDOMS_V1.md section 5 (D3 probabilistic belief machines) and section 14 criteria 3 and 4; the probabilistic-row work of RV-377-029 and RV-377-031 (the D3 row is precision-gated at 8 bits: an 8-bit posterior over 16 hypotheses underflows, and the row is admissible only at full observation and is the occupant nowhere)
original_hypothesis: Eleven domain candidates have been executed against matched strongest parents and all eleven reduced, but every one of them was a bounded composition over the primitive alphabet AT A FIXED ARITHMETIC PRECISION (GMI-DA1). If there is an ecology in which, at wide precision, the probabilistic carrier D3 occupies frontier cells that NO carrier admissible in the registered 8-bit universe occupies at any reuse horizon, then D3 is a genuine structural domain that exists only above a precision threshold -- a PRECISION-GATED KINGDOM -- and the eleven reductions were an artefact of the registered universe. If instead an 8-bit parent occupies every cell, precision is a substrate parameter and not a kingdom-maker.
minimal_proposed_change: DECLARED microscope gmi_microscope/dk_precision.py (committed 2efbcf9, before this freeze; no receipt written by that commit). INSTRUMENT LADDER fx(b): two's-complement fixed point, b total bits and b//2 fractional bits, values clamped to +-(2^(b-1)-1)/2^(b//2); b in (8, 12, 16, 24, 32) plus `wide` = unbounded integers at a declared scale 2^64. fx8 IS the registered universe (b=8, F=4, clamp +-7.9375, MUL rounding (a*b+8)>>4). A fine ladder b = 8..16 is executed for the threshold refinement only. TWO ECOLOGIES in which a calibrated probability is the only correct answer, both scored by the BRIER strictly proper scoring rule in exact rational arithmetic (fractions.Fraction; expected Brier loss = (q-q*)^2 + q*(1-q*), so excess = (q-q*)^2 and only q = q* is optimal): E_noisy (latent rule bit3, declared flip schedule at 5/24, evaluated on all 16 inputs) and E_ambig (the seen set is exactly the 8 inputs where bit0 = bit1, so the hypotheses keyed on bit0 and on bit1 are BOTH consistent with every event and disagree on every unseen input; evaluated on the 8 unseen inputs, where the correct served answer is the posterior mixture). One declared hypothesis class of 32 (8 predicates x 4 value pairs) with a declared integer predicate prior (4,2,2,2,1,1,1,1); 24 events; one revocation after event 13 removing event index 1; the served obligation q*(x) is the exact posterior predictive over the FINAL evidence. CAPABILITY = the Brier SKILL score against the declared base-rate forecaster, cap = max(0, 1 - sum_x (q_row(x)-q*(x))^2 / sum_x (qbar-q*(x))^2), theta = 0.85. ROWS: BAYES (the D3 carrier: exact posterior mixture) and the PARENT-MAXIMAL opponents of protocol rule 19, adversarially constructed: BAYESM (max-renormalized pruned posterior -- the strongest 8-bit BAYESIAN row: max-renormalization instead of sum-normalization so the informative weights never underflow merely because the class is large, plus top-4 pruning so the readout weights are ~1/4 and ARE representable at 4 fractional bits), QCOUNT (the quantized-count posterior approximator: never multiplies likelihoods so nothing underflows, counts in declared units of 1/16 so nothing saturates, top-4 pruned and normalized), MAP (the same evidence-weighing machinery served as a point estimate in hypothesis space), PROG (program search over the 16 deterministic classifiers, serving a 0/1 label), COEF (coefficient/gradient), EXEM (exemplar store), GEN (generalizing store, the S5h carrier of RV-377-025), and the negative twins UNIFMIX (mixture with the evidence discarded) and BASE (running base rate). CONFOUND SEPARATION (the whole point): every row is written with fixed-trip-count loops and no data-dependent early exit, so the charged op vector R = (desc, exec, upd, ver, rev) is IDENTICAL across instruments by construction and the receipt asserts it per row per cell; descriptions are charged on the SAME basis for every instrument (w_scalars * 8 bits + struct_bits), with a declared `scaled` sensitivity column (w_scalars * the instrument's own word width). A division is charged as a fixed 16 MUL + 16 GT macro, the same for every instrument -- a deliberate under-charge of the wide instrument, recorded as an instrument note in the RV-377-031 sense. COST MODEL C = desc + H*exec_q + r*(upd_e + ver_e) + (r/4)*rev_e, theta = 0.85, two declared price vectors (`reduced` = one charge per scalar activation; `native` = one op per state element the row's own law touches), H and r grids EXTENDED past TWICE the analytic crossover of every pair under every price vector (gap DG-2) plus the exact asymptotic occupants as H -> infinity and as r -> infinity; the H = 0 description corner is ABSTAINED (gap G3). FRONTIER RULE: PROTOCOL RULE 17 -- the frontier is over the largest declared size of each row, and a row OCCUPIES a cell iff it is admissible AND its exact-rational lifecycle cost equals the minimum over the rows admissible AT THE SAME INSTRUMENT. DECISION: A8 = the rows admissible under fx8. A cell is PRECISION-GATED for a carrier set S at instrument p iff some member of S occupies it at p and no member of A8 occupies it. The kingdom is established for S iff such a cell exists in an ecology where no member of S is itself admissible at 8 bits. The terminal is taken over S = D3 = (BAYES, BAYESM, QCOUNT), the three registered realizations of the probabilistic carrier; the exact-posterior row's own decision is reported alongside. PRE-FREEZE CALIBRATION DISCLOSURE -- THIS IS NOT A BLIND PREDICTION. Every number in clauses 1-12 was computed before this freeze, in dry runs written to a scratch path (no receipt committed). This record is therefore a REPRODUCTION-AND-STRUCTURE freeze and is labelled as such; its clauses are falsifiable by the executed receipt but they are not evidence of predictive power. Clause 13 is the only genuinely blind clause: the variant-C event sequences were written into the code before this freeze and were NOT executed before it. TWO PRE-FREEZE INSTRUMENT CORRECTIONS ARE ALSO DISCLOSED, both made to STRENGTHEN the 8-bit opponent under protocol rule 19: (a) the count-like accumulator step was changed from 1/8 to 1/16, because at 1/8 the top-4 normalizing sum of QCOUNT reached 12 and CLAMPED at 7.9375, handicapping the 8-bit opponent by an accounting choice rather than by precision; with the correction QCOUNT rises from 0.6012 to 0.8640 on E_noisy at fx8 and becomes ADMISSIBLE there; (b) the BAYESM row was added after the first calibration showed that no 8-bit Bayesian row was registered at all. Without either correction this record would have reported a kingdom on BOTH ecologies.
why_justified: GMI-DA5 already proves that admissibility is a function of the instrument; what it does not decide is whether an instrument can create a KINGDOM, i.e. a region of the resource-capability frontier that a whole precision class of carriers cannot reach. That is criterion 4 of GMI_STRUCTURAL_DOMAINS_KINGDOMS_V1 section 14 evaluated on an axis the programme has never varied. Both answers are publishable: a kingdom would mean the eleven reductions are scoped to the registered universe, and no kingdom would close the precision axis as a substrate parameter. The two ecologies are the two textbook regimes in which a calibrated probability, and not a point estimate, is the Bayes-optimal answer, and the proper scoring rule makes 'a point estimate is sub-optimal' a measured quantity rather than a definition.
new_prediction_before_outcome: (1) INSTRUMENT IDENTITY [units: operand pairs]. The fx8 instrument is BIT-IDENTICAL to the registered 8-bit universe (core.Machine.op) for MUL, ADD, SUB and GT on all 256 x 256 = 65 536 operand pairs, i.e. 262 144 assertions, all passing. (2) CHARGED-OP IDENTITY [units: charged activations]. For every one of the 10 rows in each of the 2 ecologies -- 20 row-cells -- the charged op vector R = (desc, exec, upd, ver, rev), the total charged scalar activation count, and the native op vector are IDENTICAL across all 6 declared instruments; the receipt's charged_op_identity.all_rows_all_cells_identical is true. Any capability difference between instruments is therefore attributable to precision alone. (3) 8-BIT REPRESENTABILITY IS NOT THE GATE [units: dimensionless capability]. On E_ambig the forecaster serving, at every evaluated input, the CLOSEST value on the fx8 grid (multiples of 1/16) to the exact Bayes probability q*(x) scores 0.910880 >= theta = 0.85. An admissible answer is expressible at 8 bits; every 8-bit failure recorded below is therefore a failure to COMPUTE, not to represent. (4) E_ambig 8-BIT SHUTOUT [units: rows]. On E_ambig under fx8 the admissible set is EMPTY -- all 10 rows score exactly 0.0 (BAYES, BAYESM, QCOUNT, MAP, PROG, COEF, EXEM, GEN, UNIFMIX, BASE). (5) E_noisy HAS AN 8-BIT PARENT [units: dimensionless capability, frontier cells]. On E_noisy under fx8 QCOUNT scores 0.863997, a margin of 0.013997 above theta, is the SOLE admissible row, and is the sole frontier occupant of all 36 cells under both price vectors and both description bases; every other row scores below theta (BAYESM 0.674534, all others 0.0). E_noisy therefore contributes NO precision-gated cell. (6) THE POINT ESTIMATE IS SUB-OPTIMAL, MEASURED [units: dimensionless capability]. PROG (a 0/1 label) scores exactly 0.0 in both ecologies at all 6 instruments -- 12 of 12 cells. MAP (a point estimate in hypothesis space) scores 0.800443 at wide on E_noisy and 0.0 at wide on E_ambig, below theta in both. (7) THE CLASS-FREE PARENTS FAIL AT EVERY PRECISION [units: row-cells]. COEF, EXEM, GEN, BASE and UNIFMIX are inadmissible in all 5 rows x 2 ecologies x 6 instruments = 60 of 60 row-cells, so their failure is a carrier property and not a precision property; on E_noisy at wide, COEF, EXEM, GEN and BASE are 0.0 and UNIFMIX is 0.123162. (8) THE PRECISION-GATED KINGDOM ON E_ambig [units: frontier cells]. Frontier rule: PROTOCOL RULE 17. At fx12 and at every wider instrument, on E_ambig, under both price vectors and both description bases -- 20 keys -- EVERY frontier cell is occupied by a member of D3 = (BAYES, BAYESM, QCOUNT) and by no member of A8(E_ambig), which is empty; the number of precision-gated cells per key is at least 36 and equals the key's total cell count in every one of those 20 keys. At fx8 the count is 0 in all 4 keys. (9) THE EXACT POSTERIOR IS DOMINATED BY ITS OWN PRUNED REALIZATION [units: frontier cells, charged activations, bits, queries]. On E_ambig under the reduced price and the flat description basis, BAYES occupies 0 of 42 cells at fx16, fx24, fx32 and wide; under the declared native price it occupies exactly 1 of 49 (H = 1, r = 0). BAYES costs 96 charged activations per query against 12 for BAYESM and for QCOUNT -- a factor of exactly 8 -- and its description is 544 bits against 596, a deficit of 52 bits, so the analytic reduced-price crossover is H* = 52/84 = 0.619048 queries, below the smallest non-abstained reuse horizon H = 1. (10) THE THRESHOLD [units: total bits and fractional bits]. On the declared ladder (8, 12, 16, 24, 32, unbounded) the smallest instrument at which the precision-gated kingdom exists is 12 TOTAL BITS. On the fine ladder 8..16 the smallest total width at which any D3 realization is admissible on E_ambig is 10 TOTAL BITS (5 fractional bits): BAYESM 0.954074 and QCOUNT 0.997275 at 10 bits, both exactly 0.0 at 9 and at 8 bits. The exact-posterior row BAYES needs 16 total bits (0.886352) and is NON-MONOTONE in precision on E_ambig: 0.0 at 8-11 bits, 0.456162 at 12 and 13, 0.080183 at 14 and 15, 0.886352 at 16. On E_noisy the smallest admissible total width for any D3 realization is 8 bits (QCOUNT), i.e. no gate at all. (11) SEED INVARIANCE [units: row-instrument comparisons]. No row executes a SAMPLE activation, so capability at machine seed 1 equals capability at machine seed 0 for all 10 rows in both ecologies at both fx8 and wide: 40 of 40 comparisons equal. (12) REPLICATION, VARIANT B (numbers computed before the freeze; disclosed) [units: rows]. Under the second declared event sequence (E_ambig flips at 9 and 22; E_noisy flips at 1, 7, 12, 17, 21) the E_ambig admissible set is EMPTY at fx8, exactly (BAYESM, QCOUNT) at fx12, and exactly (BAYES, BAYESM, QCOUNT) at wide; on E_noisy at fx8 the admissible set is (BAYES, BAYESM, MAP, QCOUNT), i.e. non-empty again. (13) BLIND CLAUSE -- VARIANT C [units: rows]. The third declared event sequence (E_ambig flips at 2 and 13; E_noisy flips at 0, 6, 11, 16, 23) was written into the microscope before this freeze and has NOT been executed. Predicted: on E_ambig variant C the admissible set is EMPTY at fx8, is exactly (BAYESM, QCOUNT) at fx12 and exactly (BAYES, BAYESM, QCOUNT) at wide; on E_noisy variant C at least one row is admissible at fx8.

failure_class: none: no clause failed and no instrument defect was found. The record's own weakness is disclosed rather than discovered -- clauses 1-12 were calibrated before the freeze, so only clause 13 carries predictive weight; and the two pre-freeze instrument corrections disclosed in minimal_proposed_change were each worth one ecology's verdict.
strongest_mundane_explanation: An 8-bit fixed point with 4 fractional bits cannot hold a normalized weight distribution over 32 hypotheses: the uniform weight 1/32 is below the instrument's smallest positive value, so sum-normalization drives the whole posterior to 0 or to 1/16 and the mixture collapses. Everything below is that one sentence, measured. The two ecologies were built so that only a carrier holding an explicit hypothesis class can serve the obligation at all, which is a property of the ecologies and not of precision.
strongest_parent_explanation: Numerical analysis: probabilistic inference needs DYNAMIC RANGE, not just resolution -- log-domain arithmetic, scaling and resampling exist in every practical filter and every practical Bayesian program precisely because likelihood chains and large hypothesis sets underflow. The classical statement of that is a statement about implementations; the statement here is that the same fact, priced, moves the resource-capability FRONTIER, which is theory core L3 (admissibility first) applied on an axis L4 does not contain.
measurement_validity_status: valid if clauses 1 and 2 hold: the two instruments execute identical charged operation sequences and descriptions are charged on the same basis, so a capability difference is attributable to precision alone. Declared limitations: charged ops are counted per scalar ACTIVATION and not per bit (generous to the wide instrument; the `scaled` description column is the declared sensitivity); division is charged by a fixed macro for every instrument; native prices are declared, not measured.
mechanism_attribution: precision (dynamic range of a normalized weight vector over a 32-member hypothesis class) for the D3 rows; carrier (no explicit hypothesis class, or a 0/1 served answer) for COEF, EXEM, GEN, BASE, PROG and MAP
new_invariant_learned: At scope: (i) an arithmetic instrument can move a carrier from INADMISSIBLE-EVERYWHERE to SOLE-FRONTIER-OCCUPANT while the charged operation sequence is held bit-for-bit identical -- 20 of 20 row-cells verified -- so this is the first executed instance in the programme of precision changing an occupancy verdict rather than only a capability number; (ii) the gate is DYNAMIC RANGE, not resolution: an admissible answer is representable on the 1/16 grid (0.910880) and no 8-bit carrier can compute one, because a normalized weight vector over 32 hypotheses has no representable uniform value at 4 fractional bits; (iii) the threshold is 10 total bits with 5 fractional bits for the domain and 16 for the exact posterior, and capability is NON-MONOTONE in precision for the exact posterior (0.456 at 12 bits, 0.080 at 14, 0.886 at 16), so 'more bits is better' is false for a quantized mixture; (iv) whether an ecology is precision-gated at all is an ECOLOGY property, not a carrier property: two ecologies built to the same recipe differ, because on E_noisy a count-based posterior approximation reaches theta at 8 bits and on E_ambig it does not; (v) the exact posterior is dominated by its own cheap approximations above one query, at a crossover of 0.619048 queries -- inside a precision-gated kingdom, exact inference is still not the occupant.
new_theory_constraint: GMI-DA5 is strengthened from a statement about admissibility to a statement about OCCUPANCY: at scope there exists an ecology and a reuse region in which every frontier cell is held by a carrier that is inadmissible in the registered 8-bit universe, so the ARITHMETIC INSTRUMENT IS A KINGDOM PARAMETER and not only a substrate parameter. Consequently criterion 3 of GMI_STRUCTURAL_DOMAINS_KINGDOMS_V1 section 14 must name its INSTRUMENT as well as its depth bound (gap DG-3) and its parent-maximal opponent (gap DG-5): 'no bounded semantics-preserving reduction to existing domains over the registered family AT A DECLARED PRECISION'. This is a new gap, DG-6. It also scopes section 9b: the terminal NO_NEW_KINGDOM_ESTABLISHED__NINE_CANDIDATES_EXECUTED_AND_ALL_NINE_REDUCED is now explicitly a statement about the 8-bit universe, and every one of the eleven reduction verdicts inherits an instrument qualifier. A second constraint, from clause 9: a kingdom claim must name WHICH REALIZATION of the carrier occupies the cells, because the exact-inference realization can be gated in and still be dominated.
claim_movement: D3 (probabilistic belief machines) -> PRECISION_GATED_KINGDOM_AT_SCOPE on E_ambig, EMPIRICALLY_SUPPORTED_AT_TIER exact-charged-replay, with the occupancy held by the pruned and count-based realizations rather than the exact posterior; gap G5's consequence is now EXECUTED rather than merely closed; new gap DG-6 (every domain criterion must name its arithmetic instrument) opened; no movement for E_noisy, where an 8-bit parent occupies every cell.
